text: The solicitor Renfield rides to a Transylvanian castle in a coach led by a bat and leaves as the raving servant of [a count who feeds by night|threat|blood drinkers]. Dracula [crosses to England hidden in a coffin|origin|strangers who arrive] and takes Carfax Abbey, beside Seward's sanatorium. Lucy dies after his night visit, and soon [Mina, engaged to John Harker|who_suffers|spouses and lovers], longs for nights and fogs, while Van Helsing notices [a guest with no reflection|images|mirrors and glass] and hangs wolfsbane at her throat.
